title: FCC approves SpaceX&\#x27;s 1 million-satellite Starmind data-center constellation
summary: The FCC has approved SpaceX to deploy up to 1 million satellites for Starmind, an orbital data-processing network, operating at altitudes of 500 to 1002 kilometers. The regulator called it the first US approval of a space data-center constellation. The authorization carries conditions including communications backup, periodic progress filings, and a detailed orbital-debris mitigation plan; the first satellite must be in operation no later than 2033, and the full constellation must be operating by 2040. The FCC rejected objections from Amazon, Viasat, and the American Astronomical Society.
